topic:costs-2026:funding_note:2026/27.verified_value: University-wide international scholarships can exclude Medicine: the University of Birmingham's High Fliers Undergraduate Scholarships for Africa (£5,000, 2026/27) are not open to applicants for MBChB Medicine and Surgery, and the University of Nottingham's International Undergraduate Excellence Scholarship excludes Medicine. Check each medical school's own funding page before counting on a scholarship.
topic:costs-2026:funding_note:2026/27.note: Replaces an unsourced summary. Two official examples; the general sentence says only what they show.

topic:costs-2026:funding_note:2026/27.quote: The University of Birmingham is pleased to announce the award of £5,000 for students applying for entry to an undergraduate programme starting September 2026. ... students applying for MBChB Medicine and Surgery or BDS Dental Surgery are not eligible for this scholarship. ... be starting year one of a full-time undergraduate degree programme (RQF level 4) that is UK campus-based (excludes Bachelor programmes in Veterinary Medicine and Surgery, Pharmacy, Medicine or Foundation Year)
